summary: Dead-end lane end under trees, homes 30 m or more away.
reasons: Vehicle already parked at the lane end

drivers.seclusion: Trees to the north; nearest dwellings 30-36 m south and west beyond vegetation.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane runs to a dead end with a gravel apron; a vehicle is parked there, so a van fits.
drivers.traffic: Dead end, so little through traffic; a building site sits to the east.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the lane; 2P weekday daytime signs only, nothing overnight.

flags: Building site on the east edge, possible weekday noise
sun_shade: Heavy tree cover on the north and east; mostly shaded.
cannot_judge: Whether the apron is private land

best_section.where: Dead-end gravel and sealed lane end, bush on the north side
